neighbours.label: a fixed list of capitalized, space-prefixed name tokens (surnames like ' Walsh', ' Murphy', ' Woodward', ' McConnell', ' Gregg', ' Baxter', ' Slater', ' Dawson' and some first names like ' Natalie', ' Jacques'), whether or not they name a person ('Murphy bed', 'Woodward Avenue'); very common names (' Smith', ' Brown', ' Taylor', ' Johnson', ' Emily') stay quiet, and the same name without the leading space or in lowercase does not fire
neighbours.short: certain name tokens (' Walsh', ' Murphy', ' Woodward'), not names in general
